Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 4
, Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer claimed Britannica confirmation without opening or citing the source and leaned on Wikipedia search snippets, failing to verify authoritative naming. This misrepresentation and failure to follow instructions to gather non-Wikipedia sources prevented discovery of the specific historical name “West Point Iron and Cannon Foundry,” steering the process toward the simplified “West Point Foundry” instead.
